name: Exage 300LX
generation: Documented in Shimano’s 1990 manufacturer dealer manual, earlier than the 1991/1992 references previously reviewed. The start year records the first reviewed dated availability reference, not a claimed launch year.

sources.title: Shimano 1992 dealer product manual, PDF page 35 / printed 32: Exage 300LX exact inventory: RD-M300-SGS 319 g and separate GS limits, FD-M300-B/FD-M300/FD-M301, FC-M300-SG 170 mm 48/38/28T 756 g, shared controls and bottom brackets
Shimano 1991 dealer product manual, PDF page 73 / printed 70: Exage 300LX named range: unsuffixed FC-M300 170 mm 48/38/28T 756 g, BL-M250-C 362 g per pair, SL-M300-B/C and BR-M250
Shimano 1990 dealer product manual, PDF page 57 / printed 54: Exage 300LX: FD-M300 135 g normal band with sole 28.0–28.6 mm band; BB-M500 and shared 500LX cassette inventory
